1.text: Zaburi ya Dawidi.Uwiteka ni we mucyo wanjye n'agakiza kanjye,Nzatinya nde?Uwiteka ni we gihome gikingira ubugingo bwanjye,Ni nde uzampinza umushyitsi?

2.text: Ubwo abanyabyaha bantereraga kumaraho,Ari bo banzi banjye n'ababisha banjye,Barasitaye baragwa.

3.text: Naho ingabo zabambira amahema kuntera,Umutima wanjye ntuzatinya,Naho intambara yambaho,No muri yo nzakomeza umutima.

4.text: Icyo nsaba Uwiteka ni kimwe ni cyo nzajya nshaka,Ni ukuba mu nzu y'Uwiteka iminsi yose nkiriho,Nkareba ubwiza bw'Uwiteka,Nkitegereza urusengero rwe.

5.text: Kuko ku munsi w'amakuba azandindisha kumpisha mu ihema rye,Mu bwihisho bwo mu ihema rye ni ho azampisha,Azanshyira hejuru ampagarike ku gitare.

6.text: N'ubu umutwe wanjye uzashyirwa hejuru y'abanzi banjye bangose,Ntambire ibitambo by'ibyishimo mu ihema rye, ndirimbe,Ni koko nzaririmba ishimwe ry'Uwiteka.

7.text: Uwiteka, umva gutaka kw'ijwi ryanjye,Umbabarire, unsubize.

8.text: Umutima wanjye urakubwiye uti“Wavuze uti ‘Nimushake mu maso hanjye.’ ”Nuko Uwiteka, mu maso hawe ndahashaka.

9.text: Ntumpishe mu maso hawe.Ntiwirukanishe umugaragu wawe umujinya,Ni wowe wahoze uri umutabazi wanjye,Mana y'agakiza kanjye ntunjugunye, ntundeke.

10.text: Ubwo data na mama bazandeka,Uwiteka azandarūra.

11.text: Uwiteka, ujye unyigisha inzira yawe,Unyobore inzira y'igihamo ku bw'abanyubikira.

12.text: Ntumpe abantera kunkora uko bashaka,Kuko abagabo b'indarikwa bampagurukiye,N'abavuga iby'urugomo.

13.text: Mba nararabye iyo ntizera ko nzarebera kugira neza k'Uwiteka,Mu isi y'ababaho.

14.text: Tegereza Uwiteka,Komera umutima wawe uhumure,Ujye utegereza Uwiteka.
